g.text: Privacy-Preserving, Low-Bandwidth Edge AI Monitoring Platform for Distributed PMKVY Training Centres
• Connects to existing centre CCTV cameras.
• Threaded drop-frame reader eliminates buffer lag.
• Camera Trust Check: Flags blurred/glared/covered lenses.
query decoders for dense occluded student classrooms.
• NMS-Free: Zero suppression latency or overlap drops.
• Maintains temporal motion continuity across frames.
✓ Strictly zero facial recognition or biometric profiles.
• Ray-casting algorithm maps feet to classroom polygon.
• Dwell Threshold (≥180s): Student must be present
continuously; ignores passersby walking through hallway.
• Top 35% of trainee boxes Gaussian-blurred at edge.
• Raw unblurred video never leaves the training centre.
• Full compliance with India's DPDP Act 2023.
• 15-frame temporal sliding window for computers, sewing machines & benches.
• Events stored in edge SQLite DB.
• Ingests Self-Reported Trainee Rosters from centre portal.
• Classroom ROI polygon coordinates & room capacities.
• Evaluates delta: Δ = Reported Count - Observed Count.
• COMPLIANT (≤ 15%): Natural variation, no alert triggered.
• CRITICAL (> 45%): Severe attendance / ghost trainee alert.
• Prevents alert storms during ongoing sessions.
• Deduplicates alerts within active observation windows.
• Aggregates severity updates into a single case record.
• Pushes instant NEW_ALERT notifications to officers.
• Periodic background daemon scans open discrepancy alerts.
• Unreviewed critical alerts older than 24h are escalated:
• Prevents centre monitoring officers from suppressing cases.
• National Compliance Index (94.2%), centres, camera status.
• Interactive geographic drilldown from state to centre room.
• Priority discrepancy feed with real-time audio-visual alerts.
• Live camera feed player with HUD bounding box overlay.
• Solves multi-camera overlap in large 50-seat workshops.
• Homography projection: Maps feet to room coordinates.
• Interactive evidence modal with side-by-side delta.
✓ Officers Confirm or Dismiss with required audit notes.
• Immutable chronological record of every system & user action.
• Tracks actor ID, timestamp, entity diff, and adjudication reason.
• One-click official CSV audit export for central MSDE scrutiny.
